AgeFilter (via model) · freqtrade/plugins/pairlist/AgeFilter.py:21:1

AgeFilter is a pairlist filter that keeps or drops trading pairs based on how many days they have been listed on the exchange. It is not usable in backtesting, and it tracks which symbols were already checked and which failed the check.
